title: Count sigma and pi in formamide
hints: Count each connected atom pair once.
Remember the carbonyl contributes one sigma and one pi.
Include all three bonds to terminal H atoms.
solution: There are five connected pairs, so five sigma bonds. C=O is the only double bond in the displayed structure, so there is one pi bond.
statement:
For formamide drawn as $\ce{H-C(=O)-NH2}$, how many $\sigma$ and $\pi$ bonds are there?

[_]{a}

explanations: Count H–C, C–O, C–N and the two N–H connections.
The C=O double bond has a pi component.
This has one double bond, not a triple bond.
